note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/bill-of-lading records with destination, HS code and BOL number — not by website claims. Declared HS 843139 (parts of lifting/handling machinery) does NOT match the observed export HS codes: 36020090 / 36020010 (prepared explosives, PETN/TNT), 36032000 (detonating cords/Solarcord) and 76081000 (aluminium tubes). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the explosives chapter (3602/3603) with aluminium tube 7608 as a secondary line, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is only partly right — the company is an explosives/detonators manufacturer serving mining and defence. Role: manufacturer (own plants, own export licences E/HQ/MH/8E/...). Revenue: not verified in this session — null, not invented. Domestic supply: no evidence found in this session, but this is a data-access gap, not a finding of absence — status unknown rather than none_found. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here (out of scope for this role).
